top_stories.title: Judge sides with Anthropic to temporarily block the Pentagon’s ban
top_stories.summary: A federal judge has issued an injunction temporarily halting the Pentagon’s ban on Anthropic over supply-chain security concerns. The ruling allows Anthropic to continue its government business, spotlighting debates around AI vendor risk and government procurement policies.

top_stories.title: Wikipedia bans AI-generated articles
top_stories.summary: Wikipedia has formally banned the creation of entire articles using generative AI tools, citing concerns over accuracy, reliability, and the potential spread of misinformation. The ruling aims to strengthen content quality and reinforce Wikipedia's editorial standards.

top_stories.title: Google is making it easier to import another AI’s memory into Gemini
top_stories.summary: Google's Gemini AI will soon allow users to import chat histories and 'memories' from other AI assistants, making it easier to switch or consolidate AI services. This update reflects a trend toward interoperability and user data portability in the AI assistant market.

top_stories.title: Webtoon is adding AI localization tools to its comics platform
top_stories.summary: Digital comics giant Webtoon is introducing AI-powered localization and translation tools, enabling more efficient and accessible distribution of comics worldwide. The company aims to streamline content adaptation for global audiences and expand its market using generative AI.

top_stories.title: Meet the Tech Reporters Using AI to Help Write and Edit Their Stories
top_stories.summary: Technology reporters are increasingly using AI tools to assist with drafting, editing, and idea generation in the newsroom. This article examines how the adoption of AI in journalism is raising new questions about accuracy, integrity, and the future of reporting workflows.

further_links.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash Live: Making audio AI more natural and reliable
further_links.summary: Google DeepMind details advances in Gemini 3.1 Flash Live, boosting the naturalness and reliability of audio-based AI interactions.

further_links.title: Apple will reportedly allow other AI chatbots to plug into Siri
further_links.summary: Rumors indicate Apple will soon let third-party AI chatbots connect directly with Siri, potentially opening the platform to more advanced AI integrations.

further_links.title: AI users whose lives were wrecked by delusion
further_links.summary: A report on individuals negatively affected by over-reliance on AI chatbots, highlighting psychological and practical risks of AI-driven delusion.

further_links.title: Reveal Brings Conversational AI Analytics Directly into Enterprise Applications
further_links.summary: Reveal announces a new suite integrating conversational analytics into enterprise software, offering deeper AI-driven insights for businesses.

further_links.title: School uses AI to remove 200 books, including Orwell's 1984 and Twilight
further_links.summary: A UK school used AI to curate its library, resulting in hundreds of books—including classics—being removed, prompting debate on algorithmic decision making in education.

further_links.title: EU backs nude app ban and delays to landmark AI rules
further_links.summary: EU lawmakers support a ban on 'nudify' apps and announce delays in implementing the bloc's landmark AI Act, reflecting policy debates over AI-generated content and regulation.

further_links.title: New York City hospitals drop Palantir as controversial AI firm expands in UK
further_links.summary: Faced with privacy and ethical concerns, several NYC hospitals have discontinued partnerships with Palantir, while the company continues to secure deals in the UK healthcare sector.

further_links.title: The Download: a battery pivot to AI, and rewriting math
further_links.summary: MIT Technology Review covers a company pivoting from batteries to AI, along with a feature on new generative AI tools transforming how mathematical problems are solved.

further_links.title: Chatbot Channels Introduces AI-Based Customer Communication
further_links.summary: Chatbot Channels unveils a platform for AI-powered customer engagement, aiming to improve communication efficiency and personalization for businesses.

further_links.title: Anaplan Announces AI-Driven Applications to Advance Enterprise Decision-Making
further_links.summary: Anaplan launches a new suite of AI-driven features to enhance forecasting and decision support for enterprise clients.

ethan_mollick.title: Do Not Explain My Joke
ethan_mollick.summary: Ethan Mollick discusses the subtleties of humor and interaction with AI-powered conversational agents. He warns that while AI can understand and sometimes generate jokes, over-explaining or algorithmically breaking down humor can strip away its core appeal and human context.

email_teaser: AI in journalism and publishing takes center stage as Wikipedia bans AI-generated articles, reporters turn to AI for newsroom help, and Webtoon launches new localization tools. Plus: Google and Apple ramp up competition in the AI assistant race, and a major court ruling keeps Anthropic in the Pentagon's playbook.
